note: Research kept by hand, with sources. effect 'up' = attention / reported climbing; 'supply' = more being printed / prices falling with supply. kind: 'card' (a named card reported climbing — counts as confirmed movement), 'set', 'pokemon', 'era' (a class of card), plus dated events (pokemon + date), and 'hype' (a news spike expected to cool: a warning, never a buy signal). Used by tools/picks.mjs.
